user.title: Connection Type
user.description: Select how you want to connect to your UniFi Controller.

data_description.connection_type:
Local: Connect directly to your UniFi device on your network.
Remote: Connect via UniFi Cloud using your cloud API key.

local.title: Local Connection
local.description: Connect directly to your UniFi device on your local network.

data_description.host: The URL of your UniFi device (e.g., https://192.168.1.1)
data_description.api_key: API key from your UniFi Controller (Settings → Control Plane → API Keys)
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable for self-signed certificates (common for local devices)

remote.title: Remote Connection (UniFi Cloud)
remote.description: Connect to your UniFi device via the UniFi Cloud.

data_description.api_key: Cloud API key from your UniFi account. After validation, you will choose one of the consoles that this API key can access.

select_console.title: Select remote console
select_console.description: Choose the UniFi console that you want to connect to.

data_description.console_id: These consoles were discovered with your API key.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: The UniFi Insights integration needs to re-authenticate your account.

data_description.api_key: A new API key from your UniFi Controller (Settings → Control Plane → API Keys)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the UniFi Insights integration configuration.

data_description.host: The URL of your UniFi device (e.g., https://192.168.1.1)
data_description.api_key: API key from your UniFi Controller (Settings → Control Plane → API Keys)
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable for self-signed certificates (common for local devices)
data_description.console_id: The UniFi cloud console ID this entry connects to

carrier_fabric.title: UniFi Carrier Fabric
carrier_fabric.description: Enter your Carrier Fabric ISP API key. A Carrier Fabric ISP API key (type ISP) is required; console or Site Manager API keys will not work.

data_description.api_key: An API key with Carrier Fabric ISP permissions (type ISP).

reauth_carrier_fabric.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_carrier_fabric.description: Enter your Carrier Fabric ISP API key to re-authenticate. A Carrier Fabric ISP API key (type ISP) is required; console or Site Manager API keys will not work.

data_description.api_key: An API key with Carrier Fabric ISP permissions (type ISP).

reconfigure_carrier_fabric.title: Reconfigure UniFi Carrier Fabric
reconfigure_carrier_fabric.description: Update your UniFi Carrier Fabric configuration. A Carrier Fabric ISP API key (type ISP) is required; console or Site Manager API keys will not work.

data_description.api_key: An API key with Carrier Fabric ISP permissions (type ISP).

error.invalid_console_id: The selected console could not be accessed with this API key.
error.no_remote_consoles: No remote UniFi consoles were found for this API key.
error.api_unsupported: The UniFi controller did not respond to the official Network Integration API (HTTP 404). This integration requires UniFi OS (e.g. UDM, UDR, Cloud Key Gen2+, UCG) or UniFi Cloud access. Self-hosted UniFi Network installations (Linux/Docker/Proxmox) do not expose this API.
error.site_parse_error: Failed to parse site data from the UniFi controller. Please ensure your UniFi OS controller firmware is up to date.
error.carrier_missing_scope: The ISP API key lacks the required Carrier Fabric permissions.

abort.account_mismatch: The API key provided does not match the original account. Please use the same API key or remove and re-add the integration.
abort.carrier_org_mismatch: The provided ISP API key belongs to a different organisation than the configured entry.

init.title: UniFi Insights Options
init.description: Configure additional options for the UniFi Insights integration.

data.carrier_actions: Enable service actions (suspend and resume subscribers)

data_description.track_wifi_clients: Create device tracker entities for connected WiFi clients. This may create many entities.
data_description.track_wired_clients: Create device tracker entities for connected wired (LAN) clients. This may create many entities.
data_description.client_control: Create allow/block switch and reconnect button entities for connected clients. Disable to prevent orphaned entities when clients leave the network.
data_description.site_ids: Only poll these sites. Leave empty to include every site on the console. Unselected sites are not queried, which reduces API traffic on multi-site consoles.
data_description.track_subscribers: Create device entries for each subscriber in your Carrier Fabric organisation.
data_description.carrier_actions: Allow suspending and resuming subscriber services from Home Assistant.

refresh_data.name: Refresh Data
refresh_data.description: Force an immediate refresh of UniFi Insights data.

site_id.name: Site ID
site_id.description: Optional site ID to refresh. If not specified, refreshes all sites.

site_id.name: Site ID
site_id.description: The site ID where the device is located.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The ID of the device to restart.

set_chime_paired_doorbells.name: Set Chime Paired Doorbells
set_chime_paired_doorbells.description: Choose which doorbells ring a UniFi Protect chime. The selection replaces the chime's current pairing. Leave Doorbells empty to unpair every doorbell.

chime_id.name: Chime ID
chime_id.description: ID of the chime. Not needed when the chime is picked as the target.

doorbells.name: Doorbells
doorbells.description: Doorbell ring sensors of this integration, or the doorbell devices or areas that hold them. Only doorbells on the chime's console are accepted.

carrier_suspend_subscriber.name: Suspend Subscriber
carrier_suspend_subscriber.description: Stop a subscriber's internet service. Requires the "Enable service actions" option to be enabled on the Carrier Fabric integration entry, and an ISP API key with the suspend:service scope.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason for stopping the subscriber's service (maximum 1024 characters).

carrier_resume_subscriber.name: Resume Subscriber
carrier_resume_subscriber.description: Restore a subscriber's internet service. Requires the "Enable service actions" option to be enabled on the Carrier Fabric integration entry, and an ISP API key with the resume:service scope.

power_cycle_port.name: Power Cycle PoE Port
power_cycle_port.description: Power-cycle a PoE-enabled port on a UniFi network device.

site_id.name: Site ID
site_id.description: The site ID where the device is located (optional when targeting a device).

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The ID of the device to power-cycle a port on.

cannot_connect.message: Unable to connect to UniFi controller at {host}. Please check the host address and network connectivity.

invalid_auth.message: Invalid API key. Please verify your credentials and try again.

timeout.message: Connection to UniFi controller timed out. The device may be unreachable or overloaded.

device_not_found.message: Device {device_id} was not found in site {site_id}.

chime_doorbell_not_found.message: {target} was not found. Pick a doorbell ring sensor of this integration.

chime_doorbell_not_doorbell.message: {target} is not a doorbell ring sensor of this integration.

chime_doorbell_other_console.message: {target} belongs to a different UniFi Protect console than the chime.

chime_doorbells_none_selected.message: Your doorbells selection does not contain a doorbell of this integration. To unpair every doorbell, leave Doorbells empty.

chime_cameras_unavailable.message: The chime's UniFi Protect console has not loaded its cameras yet. Try again in a moment.

no_coordinator.message: No UniFi Insights coordinator found. Please ensure the integration is properly configured.

no_protect_coordinator.message: No UniFi Protect coordinator found. Please ensure UniFi Protect is available.

global_alarm_manager.message: UniFi Protect cannot arm or disarm this alarm because the global alarm manager is enabled. Use the global alarm manager in the UniFi app instead.

carrier_actions_disabled.message: Carrier Fabric actions are disabled. Enable 'Enable service actions' in the integration options to perform this action.

carrier_target_required.message: At least one target must be specified.

carrier_multiple_targets.message: Multiple targets specified for {service}; action only supports a single target.

carrier_target_not_subscriber.message: Target {target} is not a Carrier Fabric subscriber.

carrier_entry_not_loaded.message: Carrier Fabric integration entry is not loaded.

carrier_missing_scope.message: Carrier Fabric API key missing required scope {scope} to {action} subscriber {subscriber_id}.

carrier_invalid_subscriber_id.message: Invalid subscriber ID format {target} (valid UUID expected).

siren_invalid_duration.message: The siren cannot sound for {duration} seconds. Use one of these durations: {valid} seconds.

port_not_found.message: Port {port_idx} was not found on device {device_id}.

port_not_poe.message: Port {port_idx} on device {device_id} is not PoE-enabled.
